title: The tool call already supplied the parameter (source #0) — asking for it again is avoidable (R-A12c)

asks.label: avoidable
asks.why: R-A12c added source #0: a required leaf already present in the CURRENT tool call's parameters binds instead of generating a spurious ask. The value was in hand before the ask was made, so the ask is avoidable by the strictest reading.
